[[File:Duralloy.png|thumb|right|200px|A duralloy container]]
'''Duralloy''' was an alloy used to make reinforced bunkers. A lightweight composite, it was used in [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] armor and to patch damaged [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
